view: Sardis Temple of Artemis two tall surviving Ionic columns with short lintel at eastern end and several shorter column stumps, wide stone temple foundations in foreground, steep rugged acropolis hill rising behind; only two full-height columns, not intact Parthenon.

eras.title: Two columns beneath the hill
eras.caption: Two tall columns remain at the Temple of Artemis at Sardis, beside shorter shafts and the foundations of a much larger building. Above them, the steep acropolis hill gives the sanctuary a setting that has outlasted the city's changing rulers.
